summary.description: WoW Forever preserves classic pet mechanics with normalized base speeds, native passive swing-speed inheritance, 18 pet families, the new Fox family, and 9 brand new or reworked family abilities.

families.name: Bat

newAbility.name: Sonic Blast
newAbility.desc: Emits a piercing shriek, inflicting 33 to 39 Nature damage (Rank 2) and increasing the casting time of all spells by 60% for 30 sec.

families.highlight: Potent anti-caster pet; 60% cast slow shuts down enemy healers and casters in PvP.

tameLocations.name: Mangy Duskbat
tameLocations.notes: Earliest Horde bat tame at level 10

families.name: Bear

newAbility.name: Swipe & Dash
newAbility.desc: Swipe swipes 3 nearby enemies for cleave damage every 5 seconds. Bears also learn Dash for rapid target closing.

families.highlight: Unmatched multi-target tank; Swipe cleaves 3 targets and holds dungeon pack agro.

tameLocations.name: Mystmane
tameLocations.notes: ⚡ Fastest Bear in the Game (1.6s swing speed!)

tameLocations.name: Ol' Sooty
tameLocations.notes: Named quest rare with high stamina

families.name: Bird of Prey

newAbility.name: Mine!
newAbility.desc: Grabs an enemy's weapon with its talons, causing 20 to 24 damage and physically disarming them for 4 sec.

families.highlight: Disarm specialist; strips melee weapons from warriors and rogues to neutralize burst.

tameLocations.name: Nightscreech
tameLocations.notes: ✦ Rare Hellhoot owl model in Forever

families.name: Boar

newAbility.name: Charge Rework
newAbility.desc: Charges an enemy, immobilizes it for 1 sec, and adds up to +204 melee attack power (Rank 3) to the boar's next attack.

families.highlight: Omnivorous levelling king; eats anything, root-charges targets, and has high natural armor.

families.name: Carrion Bird

newAbility.name: Demoralizing Screech
newAbility.desc: Blasts an enemy for damage and lowers the melee attack power of all enemies in melee range by 111 (Rank 2) for 30 sec.

families.highlight: AoE debuff utility; Screech reduces entire monster packs' melee damage by 111 AP.

tameLocations.name: Spiteflayer
tameLocations.notes: ⚡ Fastest Carrion Bird in the Game (1.2s swing speed!)

families.name: Cat

newAbility.name: Prowl & Lethal Speed
newAbility.desc: Stealth ambush with +50% opener damage bonus. Broken Tooth's 1.0s swing speed inflicts severe spell-pushback.

families.highlight: Maximum single-target damage output; essential for Marksmanship & BM raid DPS.

tameLocations.name: The Rake
tameLocations.notes: ⚡ Fastest Early Tame in Game! 1.2s swing speed at level 10

tameLocations.name: Ghostfang
tameLocations.notes: ✦ Rare Blue Lynx Model added in Forever (30m respawn)

tameLocations.name: Savannah Huntress
tameLocations.notes: ⚡ Very fast 1.3s attack speed, ubiquitous in Barrens

tameLocations.name: Dishu
tameLocations.notes: ⚡ Rare spotted cheetah with 1.3s swing speed

tameLocations.name: Humar the Pridelord
tameLocations.subzone: Under the large tree north of Ratchet (62, 32)
tameLocations.notes: ⚡ Legendary pitch-black mane lion, 1.3s swing speed

tameLocations.name: Broken Tooth
tameLocations.subzone: South of Lethlor Ravine / Angor Fortress (Rare)
tameLocations.notes: ⚡ FASTEST ATTACK SPEED IN ENTIRE GAME (1.00s)! The Holy Grail for PvP pushback

tameLocations.name: King Bangalash
tameLocations.notes: ⚡ Iconic white tiger boss, 1.4s attack speed

families.name: Crab

newAbility.name: Pinch & Dash
newAbility.desc: Pinches enemy legs for 32 to 36 damage (Rank 2) and reduces movement speed by 50% for 9 sec.

families.highlight: Massive +13% armor rating combined with an on-demand 50% hamstring pin.

families.name: Crocolisk

newAbility.name: Dismember (Mortal Strike)
newAbility.desc: Viciously bites enemy appendages, reducing healing effectiveness by 50% for 10 sec on a 6-second cooldown.

families.highlight: PvP meta-definer; keeps 100% uptime on 50% healing reduction without requiring an Arms warrior.

families.name: Fox

newAbility.name: Trickster's Dance
newAbility.desc: Increases pet's chance to Dodge by 50% and decreases attack intervals by 30% for 12 sec.

families.highlight: Brand new pet family added to WoW Forever! Extreme defensive evasion and rapid burst attacks.

tameLocations.name: Juvenile Vuldren
tameLocations.notes: ✦ Brand new Fox family in WoW Forever

tameLocations.name: Vuldren Alpha
tameLocations.notes: ✦ Rare pale coat fox model at level 10

tameLocations.name: Vuldren Stalker
tameLocations.notes: Teaches Trickster's Dance Rank 1 (50% Dodge, -30% interval)

families.name: Gorilla

newAbility.name: Thunderstomp Rework
newAbility.desc: Shakes the ground with thundering force, dealing 53 to 61 Nature damage to all enemies within 8 yards.

families.highlight: Area-of-effect threat burst; synergizes with Hunter traps and multi-pull dungeons.

tameLocations.name: Groddoc Ape
tameLocations.notes: Earliest gorilla tame in the game (Level 30)

tameLocations.name: U'cha
tameLocations.notes: Legendary pure white gorilla; teaches Thunderstomp 3

families.name: Hyena

newAbility.name: Tendon Rip
newAbility.desc: Tears at an enemy's legs for 21 damage over 9 sec and reduces movement speed by 50% for 9 sec.

families.highlight: Well-rounded scavenger beast with high agility, Dash mobility, and the new Tendon Rip hamstring.

tameLocations.name: Giggling Hyena
tameLocations.notes: Earliest hyena tame; teaches Tendon Rip 1

tameLocations.name: Ravage
tameLocations.notes: ⚡ Fastest Hyena in Game! 1.3s swing speed

families.name: Raptor

newAbility.name: Savage Rend
newAbility.desc: Slash an enemy with razor talons, causing target to Bleed for 54 damage (Rank 2) over 18 sec.

families.highlight: Pure offensive power with +10% damage bonus, Savage Rend bleed, and high armor penetration.

tameLocations.name: Sunscale Raptor
tameLocations.notes: Earliest raptor tame; teaches Savage Rend 1

families.name: Scorpid

newAbility.name: Scorpid Poison Rework
newAbility.desc: Inflicts 10 Nature damage over 10 sec, stacking up to 5 times. Protects Hunter Viper Sting from dispels.

families.highlight: Scorpid Poison stacks nature DoT to protect Viper Sting from dispel in PvP.

tameLocations.name: Death Flayer
tameLocations.notes: ⚡ Fastest Scorpid in Game! 1.6s swing speed

families.name: Spider

newAbility.name: Web (Root & Nature DoT)
newAbility.desc: Entangles an enemy in a corrosive web, immobilizing them and dealing 20 Nature damage (Rank 2) over 4 sec.

families.highlight: High damage ambush predator with on-demand Web roots to peel enemy melee in PvP.

tameLocations.name: Moss Stalker
tameLocations.notes: ✦ Teaches Web Rank 1 in WoW Forever (4s root)

tameLocations.name: Broodling
tameLocations.notes: ✦ Reported by beta players in Ruins of Lordaeron

tameLocations.name: Spire Spiderling
tameLocations.notes: Dungeon spider with high level abilities

families.name: Tallstrider

newAbility.name: Dust Cloud
newAbility.desc: Kicks up an abrasive cloud of dust, reducing the target's Armor by 175 (Rank 2) for 30 sec.

families.highlight: Dust Cloud strips armor for physical group burst; vegetarian diet makes feeding very affordable.

tameLocations.name: Ornery Galestrider
tameLocations.notes: ⚡ Fastest Tallstrider in Entire Game! 1.3s swing speed

tameLocations.name: Fleeting Plainstrider
tameLocations.subzone: Between Far Watch Post and Crossroads

families.name: Turtle

newAbility.name: Shell Shield Rework
newAbility.desc: Reduces all damage taken by 50% for 12 sec, increases attack intervals by 60%, but deals significantly more damage per attack.

families.highlight: Ultimate tanking pet; Shell Shield reduces all damage taken by 50% for 12 sec with +13% Armor.

tameLocations.name: Oasis Snapjaw
tameLocations.notes: Earliest turtle tame; teaches Shell Shield 1 (-50% dmg)

families.name: Wind Serpent

newAbility.name: Lightning Breath Rework
newAbility.desc: Breathes lightning, instantly dealing 32 to 36 Nature damage (Rank 3) to a single target at 20-yard range.

families.highlight: Ranged Nature damage attacks that bypass physical armor and hit high-armor plate targets.

tameLocations.name: Washte Pawne
tameLocations.notes: Rare crimson wind serpent; teaches Lightning Breath 3

families.name: Wolf
families.fastestTame: 1.20s (Deathmaw Lvl 53) • 1.40s (Coyote Packleader Lvl 11) • 1.50s (Coldrasp Ghost Wolf Lvl 12)

newAbility.name: Furious Howl Rework
newAbility.desc: The wolf howls, increasing the melee attack power of all party members within 15 yards by 31 to 38 (Rank 2) for a full 1 minute.

families.highlight: Furious Howl buffs physical AP of party members for 1 min; top raid support companion.

tameLocations.name: Worg
tameLocations.subzone: The Decrepit Ferry & The Shining Strand
tameLocations.notes: Horde level 10 wolf; teaches Furious Howl 1

tameLocations.name: Coldrasp
tameLocations.notes: ✦ RARE BLUE GHOST WOLF MODEL in Forever! 1.5s swing speed

tameLocations.name: Lupos
tameLocations.notes: Legendary Duskwood rare; teaches Furious Howl 2

tameLocations.name: Snarler
tameLocations.notes: Legendary rare wolf with +100 to all elemental resistances!

tameLocations.name: Deathmaw
tameLocations.notes: ⚡ FASTEST WOLF IN THE GAME (1.20s swing speed!) Teaches Furious Howl 4
